constraint_fidelity.evidence: Most operator answers were followed. The field is on Product, not on variants. It is plain text with a 250-character limit. It is translatable through the shared TranslationInput (saleor.diff: `storage_conditions = graphene.String(` on `class TranslationInput`). categoryTranslate and collectionTranslate reject it with INVALID (test: `assert data["errors"] == [{"code": "INVALID", "field": "storageConditions"}]`). It is in the webhook PRODUCT_FIELDS and the CSV export (`STORAGE_CONDITIONS = "storage conditions"`). On the storefront it appears only in the PDP description accordion, and no Playwright tests were added. One operator answer was broken, though. The operator asked for "A first-class nullable field on Product", but saleor.diff models.py has `storage_conditions = models.CharField(max_length=250, blank=True, default="")`, and product_cleaner.py says `# The column is not nullable; an explicit `null` clears the value.` The API therefore returns "" instead of null (test: `assert data["product"]["storageConditions"] == ""`). There is also a small change outside scope: the shared bulk-translate error path was altered for every entity (utils.py: `-                                code=e.code,` / `+                                code=get_error_code_from_error(e),`).

assumptions: The DB column is non-nullable with default "", and an explicit null is turned into "", although the operator asked for a nullable field
Existing products get "" from the migration's AddField default, and no data migration is written
Editing uses the existing MANAGE_PRODUCTS and MANAGE_TRANSLATIONS permissions, and reading is public (tested for an anonymous user)
The field is product-level only, not on variants
The dashboard hides the field on staging-schema builds via @lockSchema and isMainSchema()

The storefront trims the value, treats blank as unset, falls back to the base value when the translation is blank, and shows the description accordion even when the description is empty
categoryTranslate and collectionTranslate reject "" and null as well as non-empty values
Bulk create reports MAX_LENGTH while create/update report INVALID, and bulk-translate error codes are normalised for all fields
